2026 · Python · Claude Code Hook · LLM Security

MiniMax LockdownMiniMax Lockdown

只锁一个不太可信的模型A cage for one untrusted model

一个 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook：当前模型是 MiniMax 时启用硬拒绝、下载前询问、灰区 LLM 审计；换成别的模型直接 exit 0，零开销。A Claude Code PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook: hard-deny, ask before download, and an LLM auditor for the gray zone — but only when the active model is MiniMax. Any other model exits 0 at once.

技术栈Stack

  • Python
  • Claude Code Hook
  • LLM Security

亮点Highlights

  1. 机械硬拒绝：项目外删改、读 ~/.ssh ~/.aws、改注册表Mechanical hard deny: deletes outside the project, reads of ~/.ssh and ~/.aws, registry edits

  2. 不常见下载操作弹窗，交给人判断Uncommon downloads raise a prompt instead of a guess

  3. 独立审计模型给出 verdict + confidence + severityA separate auditor model returns verdict + confidence + severity

  4. 置信度路由与会话记忆，减少弹窗疲劳Confidence routing and session memo to fight popup fatigue
